description: This module manages Security Group on Scaleway account https://developer.scaleway.com.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: inbound_default_policy
parameters.description: Default policy for incoming traffic. Choices: "accept" "drop"

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Organization identifier. Exactly one of project and organization must be specified.

parameters.name: organization_default
parameters.description: Create security group to be the default one. Choices: false true

parameters.name: outbound_default_policy
parameters.description: Default policy for outcoming traffic. Choices: "accept" "drop"

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project identifier. Exactly one of project and organization must be specified.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example par1). Choices: "ams1" "EMEA-NL-EVS" "ams2" "ams3" "par1" "EMEA-FR-PAR1" "par2" "EMEA-FR-PAR2" "par3" "waw1" "EMEA-PL-WAW1" "waw2" "waw3"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the Security Group. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: stateful
parameters.description: Create a stateful security group which allows established connections in and out. Choices: false true

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a Security Group using a project ID
  community.general.scaleway_security_group:
    state: present
    region: par1
    name: security_group
    description: "my security group description"
    stateful: false
    inbound_default_policy: accept
    outbound_default_policy: accept
    organization_default: false
    project: 951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42
  register: security_group_creation_task

- name: Create a Security Group in the default project using an organization ID (deprecated)
  community.general.scaleway_security_group:
    state: present
    region: par1
    name: security_group
    description: "my security group description"
    organization: 43a3b6c8-916f-477b-b7ec-ff1898f5fdd9
    stateful: false
    inbound_default_policy: accept
    outbound_default_policy: accept
    organization_default: false
  register: security_group_creation_task

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: This is only present when state=present. Returned: when state=present Sample: {"scaleway_security_group": {"description": "my security group description", "enable_default_security": true, "id": "0168fb1f-cc46-4f69-b4be-c95d2a19bcae", "inbound_default_policy": "accept", "name": "security_group", "organization": "43a3b6c8-916f-477b-b7ec-ff1898f5fdd9", "organization_default": false, "outbound_default_policy": "accept", "servers": [], "stateful": false}}
